title: Strange locations
content: Hi! First time posting. For the last handful of years I’ve visited many of the same locations in my dream state - maybe some places are similar to yours? I have a whole “town” I frequent and strange planets I visited , but here are 3 places that come mind. 1) Large library settled in a downtown area - the outside it mostly grey bricked stone work , sorta similar to a brown-stone. Inside is vast, the first one or two levels in the library are clad in gorgeous wood bookshelves and all the fancies of the old-world. Then it shifts into a different vibe once exiting the library space to a large and open curved staircase leading to the lower level. The ceilings feel like they’re 30 feet tall going down. The lower level is filled with rare museum artifacts and oddities on display behind and not behind glass. This lower level is expansive - after the artifact rooms, from a narrow hall, another curved staircase continuing down leading into a “secret” room with an oddly small door. Inside the room, the roof is peaked, similar to a church. The room itself is circular. In the center is a column platform that has a the mystery set atop it…In my dream scape this room holds secrets, I’m unsure what they are in the waking realm. I’ve visited countless times. 2) a planet resembling mars- it’s a orange-red environment with a small research station settled on it. The odd thing is that the ground is crunchy and I tend to step through it and get stuck. Think of walking on styrofoam. Visited half a dozen times. 3) a sushi / Japanese restaurant on the corner of a mid-town street, urban area. Walking through a tasseled curtain after entering, the restaurant is narrow with bar sushi seating. Outside the restaurant it’s modern, mostly 80s architecture. With a trolly car track to the right continuing into midtown. I’ve visited probably a dozen times. This is fun! Ty for reading 🖤
